rationale: The only substantive ground-truth concern (yenuo26's inline comment questioning whether the test adequately verifies the reduce_scatter fix) is touched by X's finding on the same line/topic but entirely missed by Y, which outright approves. X also surfaces a plausible, well-cited structural bug (unconditional DP-metadata all_gather on a non-vLLM-owned _DP alias in non-EP paths) with concrete, actionable fixes, though some of its major findings are duplicative restatements of the same claim and rest on code outside the visible diff, so precision isn't perfect. Y's verification is accurate and well-grounded but yields almost no actionable findings and confidently approves a PR that may have a real latent issue, which is risky for a review artifact.
